senses.gloss:
Udrapāraga: : A mythical serpent.

Born in the kula of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, one of those offered in the sarpasatra; described as ‘fast as wind’ (vātavega) and ‘having excess of poison’ (viṣolbaṇa) 1. 52. 15, 1, 13.
